messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bengali, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bengali line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | In | locative preposition “in” (introduces domain) | সর্বত্র | “everywhere / in all parts” | OK | | tutte | adjective “all” (quantifier) | – | – | UNNECESSARY (covered by সর্বত্র) | | parti | noun “parts” (spatial divisions) | – | – | UNNECESSARY (covered by সর্বত্র) | | impera | verb “governs” (exerts rule) | শাসন করেন | “governs” | OK | | e | conjunction “and” (coordinates predicates) | এবং | “and” | OK | | quivi | adverb “there” (locative for second predicate) | সেখানে | “there” | OK | | regge | verb “reigns” (holds sovereign authority) | শাসন করেন | “reigns” (same lexical verb used) | OK | | quivi | adverb “there” (locative for existence) | সেখানে | “there” | OK | | è | verb “is” (copular, asserts existence) | আছে | “is / exists” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine singular) | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | sua | possessive adjective “his” (ownership) | তার | “his” | OK | | città | noun “city” (urban domain) | শহর | “city” | OK | | e | conjunction “and” | এবং | “and” | OK | | l'alto | adjective “lofty” (qualifies seat) | উঁচু | “lofty” | OK | | seggio | noun “seat” (throne) | সিংহাসন | “seat / throne” | OK | | oh | interjection “O” (vocative) | হে | “O” | OK | | felice | adjective “happy” (state of the chosen) | সুখী | “happy” | OK | | colui | pronoun “he” (subject of relative clause) | – | – | UNNECESSARY (Bengali relative clause does not require an explicit pronoun) | | cu' | relative pronoun “whom” (introduces clause) | যাকে | “whom” | OK | | ivi | adverb “there” (locative of election) | সেখানে | “there” | OK | | elegge | verb “elects” (selects) | বেছে নেন | “elects / chooses” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *tutte, parti, la, colui* – these elements are naturally omitted in Bengali because the meaning is already conveyed by other words or by the structure of the sentence. - **WRONG / MISSING**: none detected. - **GRAMMAR**: none detected – all Bengali words agree in number, person, and politeness level.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bengali script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bengali text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 127: - Original: সর্বত্র তিনি শাসন করেন এবং সেখানে তিনি শাসন করেন; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 128: - Original: সেখানে তার শহর এবং তার উঁচু সিংহাসন আছে: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
